ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels in lateral regions against 40% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle and along the leading/trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black V-shaped region extending from the peduncle; large contiguous high-intensity white regions on both lobes; multiple small, low-intensity circular 'islands' and linear streaks localized within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated convergence angle of approximately 85 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; high-frequency pixel-level peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary with distinct macro-notches located at the mid-section of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to an upward-tilted sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast 'target' patterns (dark centers with light halos) distributed across the white ventral surfaces; dense clusters of three-dimensional calcified organisms on the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel and unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) extending diagonally and vertically across the high-intensity white patches of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of barnacles localized on the distal tips; multiple circular scars distributed across the mid-lobe regions.
